item.title: Tuesday is a big primary day. Here's what you need to know
item.description: Six states are holding primaries May 19 that could help to decide the balance of power in Congress and in key state governments.

item.title: Drone strikes UAE nuclear plant highlighting risk of renewed war
item.description: A drone strike sparked a fire on the edge of the United Arab Emirates' sole nuclear power plant on Sunday in what authorities called an "unprovoked terrorist attack."

item.title: The Supreme Court avoids taking up a fight over Voting Rights Act enforcement for now
item.description: After recently weakening the Voting Rights Act, the Supreme Court avoided for now taking up a legal question that may severely limit enforcement of the law's remaining protections for minority voters.

item.title: Trump says an attack on Iran planned for Tuesday is called off
item.description: President Donald Trump said he is calling off an attack on Iran planned for Tuesday because regional leaders had urged him to allow negotiations to continue and a “very acceptable” deal for the U.S. was at hand.

item.title: Judge dismisses Trump's IRS lawsuit, paving the way for a settlement
item.description: The president sued the IRS and the Treasury Department in January, demanding $10 billion over the leak of his tax returns years ago.

item.title: What we know about the San Diego shooting victims, suspects, possible motive and more
item.description: Two teenage gunmen are believed to have killed three people at a San Diego mosque before they took their own lives, authorities said.

item.title: U.S. and Israel prepare for potential return to full-scale war with Iran
item.description: Events over the weekend highlight the risk of renewed war, as the United States and Israel signal they would be ready to fight Iran again.

item.title: High-Stakes Primary Elections Test Trump’s Influence of GOP
item.description: It is a high stakes political week for President Donald Trump with primary elections that could indicate the future of the Republican party. A key test for Trump’s power is coming up in Kentucky. The Iran war has become a central political issue for Trump and Democrats argue voters will express their frustration at the ballot box. NBC’s Ryan Nobles reports for TODAY.

item.title: Extended Interview: Tom Llamas sits down with Secretary of State Marco Rubio
item.description: On the sidelines of the Trump-Xi Summit in Beijing, NBC News' Tom Llamas sits down with Secretary of State Marco Rubio to discuss China policy, the war with Iran, the future of Cuba, and more.

item.title: North Korea is relieved its nuclear weapons have prevented a fate like Iran's
item.description: The U.S. long pushed for both Iran and North Korea to quit their nuclear plans. After seeing Iran's leader get killed, North Korea's Kim Jong Un believes he made the right choice to stay the course.
